system.description:
You weave a collection of hand seals conjuring a large incomprehensible monstrosity known as Mh'ithrha that hovers above you.

Select a number of creatures that you can see and that can see you within range, equal to your proficiency bonus. Each selected creature can see this monstrosity as its visage and design goes against all things rational and sane. The selected creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Jutsu's effects.

Success: Affected creature takes 2d8 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creature takes 4d8 psychic damage and before the end of your next turn, the next time the affected creature see’s their allies cast a jutsu, it must spend its reaction to take the Attack action, with a weapon or unarmed attack whichever has the larger damage dice and can reach, against the triggering creature. If the target is not in the attacking creature range, they move up to 15 feet closer as part of the reaction. An affected creature remakes saving throws at the end of each of its turns, ending this jutsu on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature takes 7d8 psychic damage instead.
